Article 2 (Competitions for Verification of Baduk Playing Skills)
The term "competition for verification of Baduk playing skills prescribed by Presidential Decree" in subparagraph 2 of Article 2 of the Baduk Promotion Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means a competition hosted for the selection of professional Baduk players by a nonprofit corporation that performs duties relating to the dissemination, education and international exchange of Baduk and is designated and publicly notified by the Minister of Culture, Sports and Tourism. Such selection includes selection of persons whom that nonprofit corporation recognizes as having Baduk playing skills equivalent to those of professional Baduk players, taking into account their record of participation in international Baduk competitions and other relevant performance.
